title: FR-001 Passenger registration
description: As a passenger, I want to register with a unique email so that I can access the system. Acceptance: unique email + password complexity enforced.

title: FR-002 Reject duplicate registration
description: As the system, I want to reject registration with an already-used email so duplicate accounts cannot be created.

title: FR-003 Login and session with role
description: As a user, I want to log in and get a role-tagged session so my access is scoped correctly.

title: FR-004 RBAC enforcement
description: As the system, I want to reject Passenger sessions calling Admin-only functions so privileged actions stay protected.

title: FR-005 View/update profile
description: As a passenger, I want to view and update my profile so my details stay current.

title: FR-006 Session timeout/logout
description: As the system, I want to terminate idle or logged-out sessions so stale sessions can't be reused.

title: SEC-001 Password hashing
description: As the system, I want to store only salted password hashes so credentials stay confidential.

title: SEC-002 Admin authorization test
description: As QA, I want an automated test proving Passenger sessions can't call Admin endpoints.

title: FR-007 Admin create train
description: As an admin, I want to create a train with route and capacities so it becomes bookable.

title: FR-008 Admin edit train
description: As an admin, I want to edit a train's route, halts, timings or capacities so schedules stay accurate.

title: FR-009 Admin retire train
description: As an admin, I want to retire a train so it can no longer be booked while history is preserved.

title: FR-010 Validate route graph connectivity
description: As the system, I want to validate that a train's halts form a connected path before saving so search never hits a broken route.

title: FR-011 Capacity reduction guard
description: As the system, I want to reject a capacity update below the confirmed-booking count so existing passengers are never bumped.

title: FR-012 Direct route search
description: As a passenger, I want to search direct trains between two stations so I can see what's available.

title: FR-013 Connected multi-leg search
description: As a passenger, I want multi-leg journey options when no direct train exists so I still find a way to travel.

title: Infra: CI pipeline setup
description: As the team, we want a GitHub Actions workflow building and testing every push/PR so regressions are caught early.

title: Infra: CMake build skeleton
description: As the team, we want a CMake build producing rrs_app and a test binary so everyone builds the same way.

title: FR-014 Dynamic fare calculation
description: As a passenger, I want fares computed from distance, class and concessions so pricing is accurate.

title: FR-015 Eco-routing score
description: As a passenger, I want an eco-score per route so I can compare environmental impact.

title: FR-016 Sort/filter results
description: As a passenger, I want to sort/filter results by fare, time or eco-score so I can pick what matters to me.

title: NFR-001 Search response time
description: As the system, I want 95% of searches to return within 2s on a 200-station/500-train network so the TUI feels responsive.

title: FR-018 Create booking and PNR
description: As a passenger, I want a PNR generated after successful mock payment so my seat is confirmed.

title: FR-019 No booking on payment failure
description: As the system, I want to reject booking creation when mock payment fails so no false confirmations occur.

title: FR-020 Waitlist enqueue
description: As the system, I want to enqueue overflow bookings on the waitlist in FCFS order when a class is full.

title: FR-021 Cancel ticket
description: As a passenger, I want to cancel a confirmed or waitlisted ticket so I can free my seat or exit the queue.

title: FR-022 Waitlist auto-promotion
description: As the system, I want to auto-promote the head of the waitlist to CONFIRMED when a seat frees up.

title: FR-023 Booking status display
description: As a passenger, I want to see my booking as WAITLISTED, CONFIRMED or CANCELLED so I know where I stand.

title: FR-024 Prevent duplicate booking on retry
description: As the system, I want to prevent a second confirmed booking when a passenger retries after a payment timeout.

title: NFR-002 Booking confirmation time
description: As the system, I want booking confirmation to complete within 1s under normal load.

title: NFR-009 No double-booking under concurrency
description: As the system, I want exactly one confirmed booking when 50 concurrent requests target the last seat.

title: SEC-003 Input validation
description: As the system, I want all user-supplied fields sanitized before processing so malformed input can't crash or corrupt state.

title: SEC-004 Session expiry enforcement
description: As the system, I want expired/invalid tokens rejected on every protected call.

title: SEC-005 No payment data persisted
description: As the system, I want mock payment to store only a success/fail flag, never card-like details.

title: SEC-006 Audit logging
description: As the system, I want failed logins and admin actions logged so activity is auditable.

title: Integration: end-to-end TUI demo
description: As the team, we want a working end-to-end TUI flow (search to booking to cancel) ready for the Sprint 2 demo video.

title: Security validation pass
description: As QA, we want SEC-001 to SEC-006 executed and recorded before the freeze.

title: FR-017 Search within time limit
description: As a passenger, I want search results within the NFR-001 limit on a bounded network so the TUI stays responsive.

title: NFR-003 Availability
description: As the system, I want 99% availability during the evaluation window so demos are not interrupted.

title: NFR-004 Usability: 6-screen booking flow
description: As a new passenger, I want to go from search to booking in no more than 6 TUI screens so the flow is simple.

title: NFR-005 Reliability: no duplicate on retry
description: As QA, I want a test proving a payment-timeout retry never creates a second booking.

title: NFR-006 Maintainability: modular code with unit tests
description: As the team, we want search, fare, booking and RBAC in separate modules with automated unit tests.

title: NFR-007 Testability: core runs without TUI
description: As a developer, I want core functions callable without ncurses or a live payment service so CI runs headless.

title: NFR-008 Scalability: 500 trains, 10,000 bookings
description: As the system, I want the route graph and waitlist to handle 500 trains and 10,000 bookings without redesign.
